topic: how Ford lost billions on electric cars while its business trucks earned billions
storyAngle: One Ford division pays for the bet another division is losing money on.
doNotClaim: These are segment EBIT figures (earnings before interest and taxes) for 2024, not net income.
Do not say Ford will stop making electric vehicles.

facts.claim: Ford Pro (its commercial customers business) segment EBIT for full-year 2024 was $9,015 million.
Ford Model e (its electric vehicle business) segment EBIT for full-year 2024 was a LOSS of $5,076 million.
Ford Blue (its gas and hybrid vehicle business) segment EBIT for full-year 2024 was $5,284 million.
Ford company adjusted EBIT for full-year 2024 was $10,208 million.

derived.claim: The Model e loss was about 56% of what Ford Pro earned (5,076 / 9,015): more than half.
